name: To Orgrimmar!
summary: Kaplak sends a young rogue from Razor Hill to Orgrimmar. There, you are to find Shenthul in the Cleft of Shadow and enter the Shattered Hand's network.

sections.title: A Summons to the Shadows
sections.body: Kaplak sends you north from Razor Hill to Orgrimmar. Your budding skills have caught the notice of more prominent handlers, though they remain unpolished. The red crags of Durotar are behind you as you make for the capital.

sections.title: Under Thrall's Watchful Eye
sections.body: Shenthul receives you in the Cleft of Shadow beneath Orgrimmar. He watches Warchief Thrall's political reforms with unease. The Shattered Hand cannot protect its interests through brute force or open defiance alone; it depends on patience, subterfuge, and deception to survive and preserve its influence.

faq.q: Who sends me on this quest?
faq.answer: Kaplak, a rogue trainer in Razor Hill, sends you after your skills catch the attention of superiors in Orgrimmar.
You find Shenthul in the Cleft of Shadow, an underground district beneath Orgrimmar where rogues, warlocks, and other outcasts gather.

faq.q: What is the Shattered Hand's agenda in Orgrimmar?
faq.answer: The Shattered Hand is an intelligence and assassination guild within the Horde. Shenthul is wary of Thrall's honorable reforms, and the guild relies on stealth to preserve its influence and survive.

faq.q: Why am I being sent specifically at this stage?
faq.answer: Your basic reconnaissance and skirmishes have shown you are capable, so you are being drawn into more formal guild duties. These begin with lockpicking and covert fieldwork in the capital.

faq.q: Does this quest differ from 'Find the Shattered Hand'?
aliases: find the shattered hand vs to orgrimmar
faq.answer: Both lead rogues to Shenthul in Orgrimmar. Which one you receive depends on where you train or take orders, and each advances the same training chain.

faq.q: What happens after reporting to Shenthul?
faq.answer: Shenthul tests your competence and sends you further along the chain. You meet contacts such as Zando'zan, then take on covert work involving goblin contacts in Ratchet.

angles.text: As a rogue, you are entering the capital's covert network under Shenthul's watch. The work turns to poisons, thievery, and deception beyond the frontier skirmishes.
As a member of the Horde, you hear the friction between Thrall's honorable new path and the older clan organizations that survive beneath Orgrimmar.
